# Yuvkesh Meena

> Official profile of Yuvkesh Meena, Chief Executive Officer of Gothwad Tech.

## Profile facts

- Name: Yuvkesh Meena
- Role: Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Gothwad Tech
- Gothwad Tech founder: Pawan Gothwad
- Birthplace: Dausa, Rajasthan, India
- Official profile: https://ceo.gothwadtech.com/
- Gothwad Tech public repositories: https://github.com/GothwadTech
- Gothwad Tech developer documentation: https://docs.gothwadtech.com/

## Gothwad Tech portfolio

The public repository portfolio includes products and projects across identity and productivity, communication, media and Android devices, developer tools, remote access, and education. Selected repositories include Gothwad Accounts, Gothwad Mail, Gothwad Drive, GrixChat, Indogram, GXChat India, Gothwad Meet, Kiwi Store, PlusTube, Gothwad Browser, Gothwad AI Studio, Gothwad Education, and Gothwad Remote Desktop.

## Source notes

- Yuvkesh Meena’s role and birthplace, and Pawan Gothwad’s founder role, are supplied for this official profile.
- Product summaries are based on public Gothwad Tech repository descriptions and developer documentation.
- Public repositories can include companion applications, forks, prototypes, documentation, and infrastructure. Release details, implementation, and licenses vary by project; check each linked source repository.
- This page does not claim that one person authored every line of code.
